content.text: I don't know what attendance was at Riverbend Tower Lookout on 2026-04-18, because there's no data for that day. Neither the ticketing feed nor the point-of-sale feed reported anything, so it shouldn't be read as zero visitors. The plan for that day was 236 guests, but I can't compare against it without actual figures. I can check nearby dates once the data for this day has been loaded.
